lessons.name: Catching Up
lessons.description: Meet an old friend again and say where you were with the past tense of "съм".

multiple_choice.name: Match the catching-up phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I was at home
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вчера аз __ вкъщи цял ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера аз бях вкъщи цял ден." means "Yesterday I was at home all day." Бях is the "I" form of the past of съм.

true_false.name: True or false: Byahme
true_false.sentence: "Бяхме" is the past tense of "съм" for "ние" (we were).
true_false.explanation: Correct. The past of съм runs бях, беше, беше, бяхме, бяхте, бяха.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Where were you, Ivan
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Къде __ миналата седмица, Иване?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Къде беше миналата седмица, Иване?" means "Where were you last week, Ivan?" Иване is a friendly form of address, so the informal "ти" form беше fits.

true_false.name: True or false: Pazi se
true_false.sentence: "Пази се!" is something you say when you first meet someone.
true_false.explanation: "Пази се!" means "Take care!" and is said when you part.

multiple_choice.name: Match the past of to be
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian past form of "съм".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Last summer we were
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Миналото лято ние __ на море в Созопол.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналото лято ние бяхме на море в Созопол." means "Last summer we were at the seaside in Sozopol."

lessons.name: Tell Me About Yourself
lessons.description: Talk about likes and belongings with the short possessive forms ми, ти, му, ѝ.

multiple_choice.name: Match the possessives
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Your sister
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Как се казва __ ти?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Как се казва сестра ти?" means "What is your sister's name?" Close family words in the singular take no article before ми, ти, му, ѝ.

true_false.name: True or false: Haresva mi
true_false.sentence: "Харесва ми" means "I like it", literally "It pleases me".
true_false.explanation: Correct. The thing you like is the subject, and "ми" (to me) shows who likes it.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I like reading
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На мен ми __ да чета книги.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На мен ми харесва да чета книги." means "I like reading books." The verb agrees with the activity you like, not with you.

true_false.name: True or false: Maikata mi
true_false.sentence: With close family words in the singular you add the article before the short possessive: "майката ми".
true_false.explanation: It is "майка ми", "баща ми", "брат ми" with no article. Most other nouns do take it: "колата ми".

multiple_choice.name: Match the hobbies
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each hobby to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I like to go to the mountains
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Обичам да __ в планината през уикенда.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Обичам да ходя в планината през уикенда." means "I like going to the mountains at the weekend." After "обичам да" the verb stays in the "I" form.

lessons.name: Family Stories
lessons.description: Weddings, birthdays and relatives, told in the simple past tense.

multiple_choice.name: Match the family events
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My sister got married
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Сестра ми __ миналата година.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Сестра ми се омъжи миналата година." means "My sister got married last year." A woman "се омъжва", a man "се жени".

true_false.name: True or false: Vuycho and chicho
true_false.sentence: "Вуйчо" is your mother's brother, while "чичо" is your father's brother.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Bulgarian keeps the two uncles apart: вуйчо on the mother's side, чичо on the father's.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We called grandma
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вчера ние __ на баба за рождения ѝ ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера ние се обадихме на баба за рождения ѝ ден." means "Yesterday we called grandma for her birthday."

true_false.name: True or false: Rodih se
true_false.sentence: "Родих се през 1990 г." means "I got married in 1990."
true_false.explanation: "Родих се през 1990 г." means "I was born in 1990."

multiple_choice.name: Match the past forms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English past form to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: We danced until morning
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Миналата събота на сватбата __ до сутринта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Миналата събота на сватбата танцувахме до сутринта." means "Last Saturday at the wedding we danced until morning."

lessons.name: Plans for the Week
lessons.description: Numbers up to a hundred, appointments and the future tense with "ще".

multiple_choice.name: Match the numbers
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each number to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Tomorrow I will go
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Утре __ отида на фитнес.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре ще отида на фитнес." means "Tomorrow I will go to the gym." Ще comes before the verb to make the future.

true_false.name: True or false: Nyama da
true_false.sentence: The negative future is made with "няма да": "Няма да дойда."
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Няма да дойда" means "I will not come". Bulgarian does not say "не ще".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Half past eight
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Филмът започва в осем и __ вечерта.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Филмът започва в осем и половина вечерта." means "The film starts at half past eight in the evening." Половин is used before a noun, as in половин час.

true_false.name: True or false: Shte changes
true_false.sentence: In the future tense "ще" changes with the person: "аз щя, ти щеш".
true_false.explanation: Ще never changes in the future: аз ще, ти ще, те ще. Only the main verb changes.

multiple_choice.name: Match the future times
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Tonight we will watch
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Довечера __ гледаме филм у нас.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Довечера ще гледаме филм у нас." means "Tonight we will watch a film at our place." "Няма" would need "да": "няма да гледаме".

lessons.name: Finding a Flat
lessons.description: Rent a flat and refer back to things with го, я and ги.

multiple_choice.name: Match the renting words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I will take it
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Харесвам апартамента и ще __ взема.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Харесвам апартамента и ще го взема." means "I like the flat and I will take it." Апартамент is masculine, so "it" is го.

true_false.name: True or false: Vidyah ya
true_false.sentence: In "Видях я вчера", "я" means "her", or a feminine thing.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The sentence means "I saw her yesterday". Я replaces a feminine noun.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I do not like them
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Столовете са нови, но не __ харесвам.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Столовете са нови, но не ги харесвам." means "The chairs are new, but I do not like them." Ги replaces a plural noun.

true_false.name: True or false: Tretiya etazh
true_false.sentence: "Апартаментът е на третия етаж." means "The flat is on the thirteenth floor."
true_false.explanation: Третия means "third". Thirteenth is "тринадесетия".

multiple_choice.name: Match the flat adjectives
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English adjective to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A bright kitchen
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Кухнята е малка, но много __ през деня.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Кухнята е малка, но много светла през деня." means "The kitchen is small but very bright during the day." Кухня is feminine.

lessons.name: Dinner Guests
lessons.description: Toasts and table talk, with the short forms ми, ти, му, ѝ for "to me", "to you", "to him" and "to her".

multiple_choice.name: Match the table talk
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Pass me the bread
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Може ли да __ дадеш хляба?
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Може ли да ми дадеш хляба?" means "Could you give me the bread?" Ми means "to me".

true_false.name: True or false: Nazdrave
true_false.sentence: When Bulgarians clink glasses they say "Наздраве!"
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Наздраве!" means "To your health!" and is the usual toast.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Flowers for her
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Донесох __ цветя, защото е рожденият ѝ ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Донесох ѝ цветя, защото е рожденият ѝ ден." means "I brought her flowers because it is her birthday." Ѝ means "to her".

true_false.name: True or false: Sit sam
true_false.sentence: "Сит съм" means "I am hungry".
true_false.explanation: "Сит съм" means "I am full". "I am hungry" is "Гладен съм".

multiple_choice.name: Match the courses
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each dish to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Lentil soup
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: За първо ядене има __ от леща.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За първо ядене има супа от леща." means "For the first course there is lentil soup."

lessons.name: A Day at the Office
lessons.description: Emails, meetings and deadlines, with more verbs in the past tense.

multiple_choice.name: Match the office words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I wrote an email
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вчера __ имейл на шефа си.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера написах имейл на шефа си." means "Yesterday I wrote an email to my boss." Вчера (yesterday) calls for the past tense.

true_false.name: True or false: Shefkata
true_false.sentence: "Шефката" refers to a female boss.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Шеф is the boss, шефка a female boss, and -та is the article.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The meeting started
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Срещата __ в десет, но аз закъснях.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Срещата започна в десет, но аз закъснях." means "The meeting started at ten, but I was late." The whole story is in the past.

true_false.name: True or false: Zakasnyah
true_false.sentence: "Закъснях" means "I was early".
true_false.explanation: "Закъснях" means "I was late". "I was early" is "Подраних".

multiple_choice.name: Match the office things
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each office item to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The boss asked me
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Шефът __ помоли да остана до късно.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Шефът ме помоли да остана до късно." means "The boss asked me to stay late." Помолям takes a direct object, so "me" is ме.

lessons.name: Nature and Travel
lessons.description: Mountains, rivers and lakes of Bulgaria, compared with "от" and "отколкото".

multiple_choice.name: Match the landscape
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Longer than the Iskar
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Дунав е по-дълъг __ Искър.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дунав е по-дълъг от Искър." means "The Danube is longer than the Iskar." "Than" before a noun is от.

true_false.name: True or false: Cherno more
true_false.sentence: "Черно море" lies on the eastern side of Bulgaria.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The Black Sea coast is Bulgaria's eastern border.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The highest mountain
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Рила е __ планина в България.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Рила е най-високата планина в България." means "Rila is the highest mountain in Bulgaria."

true_false.name: True or false: Kolkoto poveche
true_false.sentence: "Колкото повече, толкова по-добре" means "The less, the better".
true_false.explanation: It means "The more, the better". "Колкото ..., толкова ..." links two comparisons.

multiple_choice.name: Match the animals
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each animal to its Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Warmer than the Baltic
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Черно море е по-топло __ Балтийско море.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Черно море е по-топло от Балтийско море." means "The Black Sea is warmer than the Baltic Sea." Before a noun, "than" is от.

lessons.name: Weather and Time
lessons.description: Describe the weather and say how long ago something happened.

multiple_choice.name: Match the weather
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Take an umbrella
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вземи чадър, навън __ дъжд.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вземи чадър, навън вали дъжд." means "Take an umbrella, it is raining outside."

true_false.name: True or false: Vali
true_false.sentence: Weather verbs like "вали" need no subject: you just say "Вали."
true_false.explanation: Correct. "Вали" alone means "It is raining". Bulgarian has no "it" here.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A week ago
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Преди една __ беше много горещо.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Преди една седмица беше много горещо." means "A week ago it was very hot." Преди + a length of time means "ago".

true_false.name: True or false: Prognozata
true_false.sentence: "Прогнозата за утре" means "yesterday's forecast".
true_false.explanation: It means "the forecast for tomorrow". Утре is tomorrow.

multiple_choice.name: Match the temperatures
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: It rained all day
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вчера __ целия ден и улиците бяха мокри.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вчера валя целия ден..." means "Yesterday it rained all day, and the streets were wet." Валя is the past tense of вали.

lessons.name: Celebrations
lessons.description: Wishes for birthdays, name days, Christmas and Easter.

multiple_choice.name: Match the wishes
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English wish to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Easter eggs
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: За Великден боядисваме __ в червено.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "За Великден боядисваме яйца в червено." means "At Easter we dye eggs red."

true_false.name: True or false: Imen den
true_false.sentence: A name day (имен ден) is celebrated on the day of the saint you are named after.
true_false.explanation: Correct. For example, people named Георги celebrate on Гергьовден, 6 May.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Christmas Eve table
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На Бъдни вечер на масата има нечетен брой __ без месо.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На Бъдни вечер на масата има нечетен брой ястия без месо." means "On Christmas Eve there is an odd number of meatless dishes on the table."

true_false.name: True or false: Easter reply
true_false.sentence: The reply to "Христос воскресе!" is "Честит рожден ден!"
true_false.explanation: The reply is "Воистина воскресе!", meaning "He is risen indeed!".

multiple_choice.name: Match the party words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Decorating the tree
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На Коледа украсяваме __ в хола.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На Коледа украсяваме елха в хола." means "At Christmas we decorate a tree in the living room."
